question: During the Asian Productivity Organization’s May 2025 meeting, what leadership role did India assume?

options.text: Announced relocation of secretariat to New Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chairmanship for 2025–26**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** has assumed the **Chairmanship** of the **Asian Productivity Organization (APO)** for the year **2025–26**, marking a significant leadership milestone for the country in the regional productivity movement.
 
• The announcement was made during the **67th Session** of the **Governing Body (GBM)** of the **APO**, which was held in **May 2025**. ***Hence, the statement regarding Chairmanship for 2025–26 is correct.***
 
• India succeeded the **Republic of Korea** in this role, having previously served as the **First Vice-Chair** for the **2024–25** term.
 
• The **Secretary** of the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)**, under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, represents **India** as the **APO Director** on the Governing Body.
